title: Lutos, no irrigation, dry forecast on the Moldavian plain, mid-September
rationale: Lutos is suitable for every candidate, so grau_toamna is asserted into the top on soil plus its 'zona colinară, nordul țării' window (09-25 → 10-05). rapita_toamna is excluded on the calendar — the 'estul, vestul și nordul țării' window (09-01 → 09-10) and the Moldova window (08-25 → 09-05) both closed before the case date — and the brief would not support it anyway: 9.4 mm of forecast rain over 16 days against a crop whose critical period is September-October establishment and whose drought_tolerance is scazuta. The ordering is the drought one: secara ridicata above orz_toamna medie, on a dryland parcel with 9.4 mm forecast rain and a -4.7 mm last-month precipitation anomaly.
